detectorLimitations: Image placements include icons, decorative elements and repeated images; an image object is not necessarily a teaching illustration.
Vectors include page decoration, borders, traces and symbols; vector path counts are not figure counts.
Geometric table detection can split a table, merge a diagram or miss image/borderless tables. No table cell prose copied into deliverable.
Formula candidate line detector misses stacked fractions, equations split by ruby/spans, math drawn as vectors/images, implicit ratios and technical numeric conditions without operators.
Caption matching may identify cross-references in prose rather than actual captions; caption IDs are candidates only.
Furigana extraction interleaves readings with terms, especially units and chemical subscripts/superscripts.
TOC nearest-preceding context does not prove exact section end; nested sections on the same page need manual object association.
A complete TOC does not contain every warning, example, legend, formula or subheading; 487 is heading inventory, not total semantic knowledge count.

specificUncapturedObjects.visualObservation: Parallel-branch diagrams and stacked fraction equations depend on numerator/denominator and branch-current association.
specificUncapturedObjects.remainingWork: Transcribe relationships into controlled mathematical representation and verify derivation and unit assumptions.

specificUncapturedObjects.visualObservation: Position-specific film values, limits, quality verdicts and measurement-position labels must stay associated; structural table detections do not establish that association.

specificUncapturedObjects.visualObservation: pH concentration factor and indicator color transition have different meanings; image color alone cannot define a universal indicator rule.
specificUncapturedObjects.remainingWork: Map logarithmic relationship and indicator-specific conditions independently.

items.correction: Figure 9-3 should be 9-2; figure 9-4 should be 9-3
Table 6-13 inorganic insulation examples: mica and ceramic only; remove natural rubber.
Do not universalize K-type thermocouple range -73 to1300C; official revised text states below zero to over1000C. Actual rating depends on instrument and conditions.
Acidic oxide reacts with base to form salt; basic oxide reacts with acid to form salt. Uploaded text reverses the definitions.
Official errata changes phosphorus oxide example to 三酸化リン(P2O3); uploaded name/formula inconsistent. Avoid phosphorus oxide example until independently resolving naming/formula; use CO2/SO2 examples.
Section label (3)特徴 should be (2)特徴.
Anodizing equation must retain oxide-ion 2- charge, including 2Al3+ + 3O2- -> Al2O3. Verify superscripts visually; text extraction loses them.

additionalSourceAmbiguities.detail: Uploaded eddy-current thickness-meter description calls zinc/copper/aluminium plating nonconductive. Do not reuse that application rule without manufacturer/standard verification. Authored lesson003 deliberately lists principles without that universal mapping.

Normality prose instructs dividing molarity by acid/base valence, but same-page sulfuric-acid example applies multiplication. Do not teach the division rule; equivalent factor depends on specified reaction.
additionalSourceAmbiguities.authoredBatch02Mitigation: Lesson011 teaches g/L and mol/L only and explicitly avoids adopting contradictory normality rule.
additionalSourceAmbiguities.resolutionNeeded: Verify against authoritative chemistry definition and specified reaction before authoring normality calculations.

referenceCorrections.issue: Prior QA message incorrectly called section9.2/PDF119 the explicit density definition; section9.2 is voltage and only mentions density limit. Explicit current/area definition is PDF157.
